context:
Goal: the phone app does everything the web app does, photos included.
Problem (goal): five debts say "the owner names the lane". The phone has photo views, but no screen shows them, nothing takes a photo, nothing syncs photos with the Worker, nothing fetches photos before a merge, and nothing removes unused ones. The Ledger tab lacks the web's View group (Showing, Sorted by, Orders from). No test scans SwiftUI view state for stored keys.
Based on (read): PhotoSync and PhotoCapture have no caller on main, and Info.plist has no camera permission line.
Based on (read): the lane plan gives Photo* files to the pins lane and the screens to the restyle lane.
Departs from: main has no lane for these five debts — option a gives the photo wiring and the key scan to the pins lane, and the View group and photo screens to the restyle lane after step 10.
Meanwhile: nothing is built.
home: pins lane: photo wiring and key scan; restyle lane after step 10: photo screens, camera and View group

options.gain: Photos and the View group reach the phone, using lanes that already own those files.
options.how: After its last three debts, the pins lane wires PhotoSync, the pre-merge fetch, the sweep and the key scan, with swift test only. Restyle builds the photo screens, the camera control and the View group after step 10.
options.label: Pins takes photo wiring and the key scan; restyle takes the screens after step 10
options.lose: The screens wait for restyle's queue; the camera needs your device check.

options.how: No lane starts on these until restyle step 10 lands.
options.label: All of it waits until the restyle goal is done
options.lose: The phone has no photos for longer.

options.gain: Less to build and keep up.
options.how: The phone drops its photo code; the View group and key scan go to restyle after step 10.
options.label: Photos stay web-only
options.lose: You can't add or see photos from the phone.

ref: debts native-photo-screens-unwired, native-merge-skips-photo-fetch, native-photo-sweep-unbuilt, native-ledger-tab-unbuilt, native-key-scan-skips-views; decision native-build-lanes
title: Photos, the Ledger View group and a key scan have no lane on the phone. Who builds them, and when?
why: Each part goes to the lane that already owns its files, and the wiring needs no simulator, so it adds no wait to the restyle.
